name: sshville
description: Manage multiple SSH remote connections; auth via MetaMask (ETH personal_sign) or SubWallet/Polkadot.js (sr25519, Bittensor-compatible). Rust axum backend.

auth_schemes.name: sub
auth_schemes.scheme: Polkadot.js / SubWallet signRaw (Bittensor SS58 prefix=42 by default)

/challenge.docs: Return the challenge text the wallet must sign for auth, plus accepted X-Mod-Auth schemes (eth / sub)

/connections.docs: List the caller's SSH connections (metadata only, no secrets)

/connections/{id}.docs: Fetch (with ciphertext) or delete a single connection

/connections/add.docs: Add or upsert an SSH connection. Body: { name, host, port, user, auth_type, ciphertext, iv }

/connections/{id}/test.docs: Open a transient SSH session to verify reachability. Body: { secret } where secret is the decrypted password or private key

/connections/{id}/exec.docs: Run a one-shot command over SSH. Body: { secret, command }
